walkthrough: Goal: V大's 变调 (week 5): a crop of a real picture painted again as if its whole key had shifted toward a tendency colour the exercise gives, warm or cool, pure or grey. As he teaches it: look at the tendency first; lay the largest colour first, the whole picture shifted; the greys move most and gain a little chroma; the colours opposite the tendency move only a little and turn greyer; the lightest barely move; every area keeps its lightness; and after the shift the areas are still apart. A key shift has no standard answer, so Compare gives none: it marks only what is off.
Entry without a pack holding crops: All units from the home shows the path's units; key shifts are unit 5, and a lesson of them needs a pack holding crops. Home, the practice options.
Import practice pack…: the harness answers with its test crops (pictures of known areas standing in for the real packs' crops). The notice says the pack's crops come up in colour combinations.

A lesson of Key shifts at level 1 from the home holds one key shift, its How first. Title: Shift the key; Week 5 · a crop painted again as if seen in another light: every colour moved toward a tendency, its lightness kept. The example, a crop of five areas beside its copy's frame, under them a chip and the tendency's disc, an orange: the tendency ringed in pencil (step 1), the frame filled with the largest area's colour shifted, a red-brown turned toward orange (2), the grey moved most and given a little chroma (3), the blue opposite moved a little and greyed (4), the light cream barely moved (5), the ochre last, its edge with its nearest neighbour pencilled, still apart (6); the chip shows each area as it is painted, its colour, an arrow, its shifted colour. Compare: both frames turn grey and match, lightness kept. One paragraph says what Compare marks.

Got it. The crop in the left frame, locked; an empty frame of its shape on the right; beside it the tendency, a filled disc with Tendency (倾向色) small and grey under it. The tools as a colour combination's: the wheel, Fill frame, Undo, Redo, Big, Small, Soft and the eyedropper. The eyedropper on the crop takes nothing and says the crop is locked; on my own paint it picks my colour.
Paint: a warm grey picked and Fill frame, the overall tone; then strokes of Big in a darker colour across part of the frame; Undo takes the last stroke back, Redo returns it.

Compare: nothing is laid over my copy, there is no answer. Red outlines on my copy's areas that are off, and on the card under its title one line for each check that failed, each after a red dot: so many areas lighter or darker than the crop's (lightness kept), so many that did not move toward the tendency (greys included), so many areas apart in the crop that merged in mine. Then Grey, the swatches (the crop's colour over mine, the failing ones ringed red; a tap chooses one), the hue and chroma disc (each crop colour a small ring, mine a dot, an arrow between; the tendency a larger disc; Gurney's gamut mask, a triangle from the tendency across the grey centre, the outside veiled in paper) and the chosen area's lightness bar, the crop's tick and mine and the difference in numbers.
Another swatch: its area outlined in ink on both frames, its lightness bar. Grey: both frames in grey (Oklab lightness), only the lightness failures outlined; Grey again: colour.
A stroke after Compare takes the comparison away, as on every sheet; Undo takes the stroke back; Compare again shows the marks as before.

Finish: the lesson's end, Key shifts, 1 exercise, its dot; One more names Key shifts again (unit 5 chosen while unit 1 is in hand), not the path's next. One more: a second lesson of Key shifts (what its card named) on the next row of the same sheet, Lesson 2 · Key shifts; the crop that came out Again is laid again first, a tendency of its own, never near the crop's own main hue.
Reopen: Home leaves it under way; Continue (Start while no lesson is under way) on the home reopens it at its key shift.
